"""Saved-only crosswalk analysis for an exact original attempt."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from canonical_evidence import build_result
from saved_crosswalk_finalizer import finalize

SOURCES = ("context.json", "trace.jsonl", "frame-map.jsonl", "receipt.json",
           "overview.mkv", "approach.mkv", "reference_corner.mkv", "driver_reference.mkv")


def measure_crosswalk_observation(finalized: dict) -> dict:
    measured = finalized["measured_values"]
    observed = finalized["observed"]
    if not isinstance(measured, dict) or not isinstance(observed, dict):
        raise ValueError("original crosswalk measurement required")
    return {"measured_values": measured, "observed": observed,
            "target_checks": finalized["target_checks"],
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def run(attempt: str | Path, output: str | Path, case_id: str,
        fixture_mode: bool = False) -> dict:
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    target = Path(output).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir() or target.parent != root or target.name != "analysis-report.json":
        raise ValueError("analysis report must be inside the saved original attempt")
    if target.exists() or (root / "result.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("retain prior analysis result and report")
    hashes = {}
    for name in SOURCES:
        path = root / name
        if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    finalized = finalize(directory=root, case_id=case_id, fixture_mode=fixture_mode)
    if finalized.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("saved finalizer returned another exact case")
    if any(hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest
           for name, digest in hashes.items()):
        raise ValueError("saved analysis changed original source")
    native_result = build_result(root, case_id, finalized, fixture_mode=fixture_mode)
    report = {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case_id,
              "measurements": {"crosswalk_observation": {
                  "value": measure_crosswalk_observation(finalized),
                  "method": "measure_crosswalk_observation", "sources": hashes}},
              "analysis_complete": True, "source_hashes": hashes,
              "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_acceptance_claimed": False,
              "source_scope": "diagnostic_software_fixture" if fixture_mode else "original_native_capture"}
    with (root / "result.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(native_result, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    return report


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    case_id = args.case
    if case_id is None:
        config = Path(args.attempt) / "config.json"
        if not config.is_file():
            raise ValueError("exact materialized case config required")
        case_id = json.loads(config.read_text())["selected_case_id"]
    fixture_mode = os.environ.get("SCENARIO_WORKER_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPATIBILITY") == "1"
    print(json.dumps(run(args.attempt, args.output, case_id, fixture_mode=fixture_mode), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Build source-limited canonical semantic drafts for six exact crosswalk cases."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from case_construction import CASES
from crosswalk_measurements import ASSIGNMENT_ID

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LAW = "LVMC-11-30-030"
ACTOR = "motor_vehicle_driver"
TEMPLATE = LAW + "@" + ACTOR
JUDGMENTS = (
    ("unmarked crosswalk at an intersection", "Actual road intersection, sidewalk lateral lines and curb or traveled-edge definition need original source review."),
    ("to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway", "Lead stop purpose needs an independent original source; pedestrian movement alone cannot prove purpose."),
    ("approaching from the rear", "Original actor body history and road direction must establish the relative approach."),
    ("overtake and pass such stopped vehicle", "Original full body sequence must establish passage while the lead remains stopped; no numerical legal cutoff is supplied."),
)


def _write(path: Path, value: dict):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def recording_description() -> dict:
    def channel(name, method):
        return {"name": name, "unit": "structured record", "sampling_rate_hz": 20,
                "method": method, "time_window": "45 s original approach, lead stop and crossing",
                "reference_frame": "source-hashed Native world XY and elapsed time",
                "uncertainty": "20 Hz samples and physical visibility require original review"}
    return {"channels": [
        channel("ego_body_history", "Original ego eight-vertex body, center and velocity every Native tick"),
        channel("lead_body_history", "Original lead eight-vertex body, center and velocity every Native tick"),
        channel("original_actor_body_sequence", "Original joined ego/lead/pedestrian actor identities, bodies and speeds"),
        channel("pedestrian_history", "Original pedestrian center and actor identity every Native tick"),
        channel("four_camera_frame_map", "Four original RGB camera frames joined to each Native tick"),
        channel("complete_native_source_and_pixels", "Full original actor trace and decoded four-view pixels at every Native tick")],
        "context_inputs": [
            {"name": "intersection_crosswalk_geometry", "unit": "source packet",
             "method": "SHA-bound OpenDRIVE, intersection, opposite sidewalks, curb/edge and marking source where applicable"},
            {"name": "lead_stop_purpose", "unit": "original observer statement",
             "method": "Independently cited and SHA-bound source distinct from pedestrian motion"},
            {"name": "original_crosswalk_and_purpose", "unit": "source packet",
             "method": "Cited original road intersection, crossing geometry and independent stop-purpose source"}],
        "limitations": ["Sampled motion and pixels cannot alone establish legal crosswalk status or driver purpose.",
                        "Physical passage and visibility require original Native review; legal judgment remains unresolved."]}


def build() -> dict:
    assignment = json.loads((HERE.parents[1] / "inputs" / ASSIGNMENT_ID / "assignment.json").read_text())
    plan = json.loads((HERE / "case-plan.json").read_text())
    quote = assignment["law"]["text"]
    if plan.get("law_text") != quote or len(plan.get("cases", [])) != len(CASES):
        raise ValueError("exact source law and six planned cases required")
    proposals = HERE / "proposals"
    relevance = {"cell_id": "C229023", "actor": ACTOR, "status": "draft",
                 "relevant_laws": [{"law_id": LAW, "quote": quote, "applies_to": [ACTOR],
                                    "relevance_type": "stopped-crosswalk rear overtaking prohibition",
                                    "confidence": "low", "notes": "Broad road cell needs original road-intersection, crosswalk and stopped-purpose review."}],
                 "borderline_excluded": []}
    for name in ("relevance_batch", "relevance"):
        _write(proposals / (name + ".json"), relevance)
    judgments = [{"phrase": phrase, "note": note} for phrase, note in JUDGMENTS]
    template = {"template_id": TEMPLATE, "law_id": LAW, "actor": ACTOR, "quote": quote,
                "structure": {"law_id": LAW,
                              "activation": {"condition": "A vehicle is stopped at a marked crosswalk or an unmarked crosswalk at an intersection to permit pedestrian crossing; another driver approaches from the rear.",
                                             "numeric_conditions": []},
                              "obligation": {"description": "The rear-approaching driver shall not overtake and pass the stopped vehicle.",
                                             "type": "must_not", "numeric_conditions": []},
                              "exceptions": [],
                              "timing": {"description": "Observe lead stopped state, rear approach and complete passage in original frame order.",
                                         "numeric_conditions": []},
                              "judgment_calls_needed": judgments},
                "parameter_refs": [
                    {"name": "crosswalk_kind", "kind": "world_setup", "range_or_domain": "source-marked or source-defined unmarked intersection crosswalk"},
                    {"name": "ego_behavior", "kind": "controller", "range_or_domain": "wait or pass request, measured afterward"},
                    {"name": "lead_stop_purpose", "kind": "world_setup", "range_or_domain": "independently sourced pedestrian-permitting or other purpose"}]}
    _write(proposals / "template.json", template)
    judgment_paths = []
    for index, (phrase, note) in enumerate(JUDGMENTS, 1):
        name = f"judgment-{index}.json"
        requirements = {"observables": [
            {"name": "original_actor_body_sequence", "unit": "structured record",
             "description": "Original 20 Hz identities, centers, body vertices and speeds for both vehicles and pedestrian."}],
            "context_inputs": [
                {"name": "original_crosswalk_and_purpose", "unit": "source packet",
                 "description": "Independent map, crossing geometry and stopped-purpose citations."}],
            "sweep_dimensions": [{"name": "crosswalk_kind_and_ego_request", "unit": "categorical",
                                  "description": "Exact marked/unmarked and wait/pass alternatives held fixed by declared comparison."}],
            "landmarks": [],
            "recording_needs": [{"name": "complete_native_source_and_pixels", "unit": "structured record",
                                 "description": "Full 900-tick actor trace, frame map and four decoded original views."}],
            "limitations": [note, "No legal conclusion follows from a controller request or synthetic CPU fixture."]}
        _write(proposals / name, {"template_id": TEMPLATE, "phrase": phrase, "note": note,
                                  "status": "draft", "observable_requirements": requirements})
        judgment_paths.append(name)
    variables = [{"name": name, "kind": kind, "range_or_domain": domain, "used_by_laws": [LAW]}
                 for name, kind, domain in (
                     ("crosswalk_kind", "world_setup", "marked or unmarked, source-backed"),
                     ("ego_behavior", "controller", "wait or pass request; actual motion measured"),
                     ("lead_stop_purpose", "world_setup", "independent observer source claim"))]
    _write(proposals / "bindings.json", {"cell_id": "C229023", "actor": ACTOR, "status": "draft",
                                      "established_contexts": ["assigned broad road cell; actual intersection and crossing source review pending"],
                                      "law_refs": [{"template_id": TEMPLATE, "binding_kind": "direct"}],
                                      "context_refs": [], "fixed_parameters": [], "variable_parameters": variables})
    recording = recording_description()
    baseline_row = plan["cases"][0]
    cases = [{"case_id": ASSIGNMENT_ID + "__baseline", "target_law_id": None,
              "target_type": "baseline", "rationale": "Shared semantic reference; no additional selected recording.",
              "variable_assignments": {
                  "crosswalk_kind": {"kind": "world_setup", "value": baseline_row["crosswalk_kind"]},
                  "ego_behavior": {"kind": "controller", "value": baseline_row["ego_maneuver_request"]},
                  "lead_stop_purpose": {"kind": "world_setup", "value": baseline_row["stopped_vehicle_purpose_claim"]}},
              "recording_description": recording, "unresolved_judgment_calls": []}]
    for row in plan["cases"]:
        suffix = row["case_id"].removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT_ID + "__")
        crossing, behavior, purpose = CASES[suffix]
        if (row["crosswalk_kind"], row["ego_maneuver_request"], row["stopped_vehicle_purpose_claim"]) != (crossing, behavior, purpose):
            raise ValueError("exact case alternatives changed")
        assignments = {"crosswalk_kind": {"kind": "world_setup", "value": crossing},
                       "ego_behavior": {"kind": "controller", "value": behavior},
                       "lead_stop_purpose": {"kind": "world_setup", "value": purpose}}
        differences = [name for name, value in assignments.items()
                       if value["value"] != cases[0]["variable_assignments"][name]["value"]]
        cases.append({"case_id": row["case_id"], "target_law_id": LAW, "target_type": "boundary_probe",
                      "rationale": "Source-bound exact alternative and controlled comparison; no legal outcome is asserted.",
                      "variable_assignments": assignments, "recording_description": recording,
                      "unresolved_judgment_calls": [phrase for phrase, _ in JUDGMENTS],
                      "paired_probe_id": "crosswalk_stop_and_pass_contrasts",
                      "deliberate_differences": differences,
                      "probe": {"primary_variable": differences[0] if differences else "ego_behavior",
                                "comparison_or_standard": "observed original actor sequence",
                                "target_value_or_branch": suffix}})
    sweeps = [{"sweep_id": f"crosswalk-judgment-{index}", "target_law_id": LAW,
               "judgment_refs": [{"phrase": phrase, "note": note}], "status": "incomplete",
               "rationale": "Source and original physical review remain necessary; no numeric legal cutoff inferred.",
               "missing_inputs": ["reviewed original intersection/crosswalk/purpose source and Native acquisition"]}
              for index, (phrase, note) in enumerate(JUDGMENTS, 1)]
    _write(proposals / "cases.json", {"cell_id": "C229023", "actor": ACTOR, "status": "draft",
                                   "sweeps_expanded": True, "sweep_specs": sweeps, "cases": cases})
    paths = {"relevance_batch": "relevance_batch.json", "relevance": "relevance.json",
             "template": "template.json", "judgment_observables": judgment_paths,
             "bindings": "bindings.json", "cases": "cases.json"}
    stages = {key: ([{"path": "proposals/" + name,
                      "sha256": hashlib.sha256((proposals / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for name in names]
                    if isinstance(names, list) else {"path": "proposals/" + names,
                                                      "sha256": hashlib.sha256((proposals / names).read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
              for key, names in paths.items()}
    index = {"format": "worker-semantic-delivery", "assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT_ID,
             "stages": stages, "status": "draft_original_source_and_physical_review_pending"}
    _write(proposals / "semantic-index.json", index)
    return index


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build()
    print("built four source-limited judgment proposals and six exact cases")

"""Project a sealed Native crosswalk capture into canonical recording evidence.

This writes derived files into a saved attempt. Original acquisition is read only.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from build_semantic_draft import recording_description
from crosswalk_measurements import ASSIGNMENT_ID


def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line]


def _write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        for row in rows:
            stream.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def project(attempt: str | Path, case_id: str, media: dict | None = None,
            fixture_mode: bool = False) -> tuple[dict, list[dict], dict]:
    """Return the frozen channel plan, references and source-bound derived files."""
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    source_names = ("context.json", "trace.jsonl", "frame-map.jsonl", "receipt.json")
    sources = {name: root / name for name in source_names}
    if any(not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() for path in sources.values()):
        raise ValueError("complete original crosswalk source set required")
    before = {name: _sha(path) for name, path in sources.items()}
    context = json.loads(sources["context.json"].read_text())
    receipt = json.loads(sources["receipt.json"].read_text())
    trace = _rows(sources["trace.jsonl"])
    mapping = _rows(sources["frame-map.jsonl"])
    if (case_id != context.get("case_id") or case_id != receipt.get("case_id") or
            receipt.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT_ID or receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not fixture_mode or
            len(trace) != len(mapping) or len(trace) != 900 or receipt.get("frame_count") != 900 or
            receipt.get("fps") != 20 or before["context.json"] != receipt.get("context_sha256") or
            before["trace.jsonl"] != receipt.get("trace_sha256") or
            before["frame-map.jsonl"] != receipt.get("frame_map_sha256")):
        raise ValueError("exact sealed 900-frame Native crosswalk source required")
    for index, (row, frame) in enumerate(zip(trace, mapping)):
        if (frame.get("video_frame") != index or frame.get("carla_frame") != row.get("frame") or
                frame.get("time_s") != row.get("time_s") or
                abs(row["time_s"] - index / 20) > 1e-5):
            raise ValueError("original actor/frame-map identity or cadence differs")
        for role in ("ego", "lead"):
            center = row.get(role + "_center")
            vertices = row.get(role + "_vertices")
            if (not isinstance(center, list) or len(center) != 2 or
                    not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) != 8 or
                    not all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(v)
                            for v in center)):
                raise ValueError("original actor geometry missing")
        if not isinstance(row.get("pedestrian_center"), list) or len(row["pedestrian_center"]) != 2:
            raise ValueError("original pedestrian center missing")
    video_binding = None
    if media is not None:
        videos = media.get("videos")
        if (media.get("case_id") != case_id or
                media.get("frame_map_sha256") != before["frame-map.jsonl"] or
                not isinstance(videos, dict) or
                set(videos) != {"overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference"}):
            raise ValueError("saved four-view decoded media differs from original capture")
        video_binding = {}
        for name, decoded in videos.items():
            path = root / (name + ".mkv")
            if (not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or decoded.get("frames") != 900 or
                    decoded.get("video_sha256") != _sha(path) or
                    not isinstance(decoded.get("rgb_sha256"), str) or
                    len(decoded["rgb_sha256"]) != 64):
                raise ValueError("saved decoded camera source differs: " + name)
            video_binding[name] = {"video_sha256": decoded["video_sha256"],
                                   "decoded_rgb_sha256": decoded["rgb_sha256"]}
    planned = recording_description()
    channel_values = {
        "ego_body_history": [{"center": r["ego_center"], "vertices": r["ego_vertices"],
                              "speed_mps": r["ego_speed_mps"]} for r in trace],
        "lead_body_history": [{"center": r["lead_center"], "vertices": r["lead_vertices"],
                               "speed_mps": r["lead_speed_mps"]} for r in trace],
        "original_actor_body_sequence": [{"ego": r["ego_center"], "lead": r["lead_center"],
                                          "pedestrian": r["pedestrian_center"],
                                          "sources": r["actor_sources"]} for r in trace],
        "pedestrian_history": [{"center": r["pedestrian_center"],
                                "source": r["actor_sources"]["pedestrian"]} for r in trace],
        "four_camera_frame_map": mapping,
        "complete_native_source_and_pixels": [
            {"actor_source": r["actor_sources"], "camera_frame": m["video_frame"],
             "carla_frame": m["carla_frame"], "decoded_media": video_binding}
            for r, m in zip(trace, mapping)],
    }
    if {c["name"] for c in planned["channels"]} != set(channel_values):
        raise ValueError("canonical channel plan differs from source projection")
    derived = root / "canonical-evidence"
    derived.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    evidence = []
    for channel in planned["channels"]:
        name = channel["name"]
        path = derived / (name + ".jsonl")
        _write_jsonl(path, [{"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": value}
                            for row, value in zip(trace, channel_values[name])])
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"],
                         "reference": str(path.relative_to(root))})
    source_context = {
        "intersection_crosswalk_geometry": {
            "map_sha256": context["map_sha256"], "junction_kind": context["junction_kind"],
            "crosswalk": context["crosswalk"], "road_axis": context["road_axis"]},
        "lead_stop_purpose": context["stopped_vehicle_purpose"],
        "original_crosswalk_and_purpose": {
            "crosswalk": context["crosswalk"],
            "purpose": context["stopped_vehicle_purpose"],
            "source_sha256": before},
    }
    context_path = derived / "context.json"
    context_path.write_text(json.dumps(source_context, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    for item in planned["context_inputs"]:
        if item["name"] not in source_context:
            raise ValueError("canonical context input missing")
        evidence.append({"name": item["name"], "unit": item["unit"],
                         "reference": str(context_path.relative_to(root))})
    if any(_sha(path) != before[name] for name, path in sources.items()):
        raise ValueError("canonical projection changed original acquisition")
    return planned, evidence, before


def build_result(attempt: str | Path, case_id: str, finalized: dict,
                 fixture_mode: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Build a native result from original sources and saved measurements.

    Source presence and sampled target matching are reported separately from
    physical causation and any legal judgment, which remain unverified.
    """
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    if finalized.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("saved crosswalk measurement case differs")
    media = finalized.get("media")
    if not isinstance(media, dict):
        raise ValueError("saved four-view decode audit required")
    if finalized.get("diagnostic_fixture", False) is not fixture_mode:
        raise ValueError("saved measurement source scope differs")
    planned, evidence, hashes = project(root, case_id, media, fixture_mode=fixture_mode)
    context = json.loads((root / "context.json").read_text())
    trace = _rows(root / "trace.jsonl")
    axis = context["road_axis"]["forward"]
    heading = math.degrees(math.atan2(axis[1], axis[0]))
    native_trace = root / "canonical-evidence/native-trace.jsonl"
    _write_jsonl(native_trace, [
        {"frame": row["frame"], "time_s": row["time_s"],
         "position": {"x": row["ego_center"][0], "y": row["ego_center"][1],
                      "z": sum(vertex[2] for vertex in row["ego_vertices"]) / 8},
         "heading_deg": heading, "speed_mps": row["ego_speed_mps"]}
        for row in trace])
    checked = []
    for item in finalized["target_checks"]:
        if not isinstance(item.get("measured"), bool) or not isinstance(item.get("requested"), bool):
            raise ValueError("saved observation target must be explicit boolean")
        checked.append({"target": item["target"], "requested": item["requested"],
                        "measured": item["measured"],
                        "method": "sealed original 20 Hz actor geometry and speed samples",
                        "tolerance": 0, "matched": item["matched"],
                        "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                        "cause_evidence": {"status": "independent physical review pending"}})
    if len(checked) != 4:
        raise ValueError("four exact crosswalk observation targets required")
    videos = [name + ".mkv" for name in
              ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")]
    if any(not (root / name).is_file() for name in videos):
        raise ValueError("four saved Native camera sources required")
    if any(_sha(root / name) != digest for name, digest in hashes.items()):
        raise ValueError("native result projection changed original acquisition")
    return {"case_id": case_id, "measured_values": finalized["measured_values"],
            "target_checks": checked, "setup_confirmed": False,
            "behavior_attempted": False, "maneuver_completed": False,
            "termination_reason": ("Diagnostic software fixture measured; original physical capture pending"
                                   if fixture_mode else "Original capture measured; independent physical review pending"),
            "physical_failure_flags": {"physical_review_pending": True},
            "trace_reference": str(native_trace.relative_to(root)),
            "video_references": videos, "video_frame_map_reference": "frame-map.jsonl",
            "recording_description": planned, "recording_evidence": evidence,
            "realized_observables": {},
            "source_sha256": {**hashes, **{name + ".mkv": item["video_sha256"]
                                          for name, item in media["videos"].items()}},
            "physical_acceptance": "unverified", "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}

{

"""Select a slower new attempt from sealed original crossing timing.

This evaluates an engineering retry trigger, never a legal conclusion or a
claim that the fallback physically succeeds.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from crosswalk_measurements import measure


def evaluate(*, case_id: str, context_path: str | Path,
             trace_path: str | Path, receipt_path: str | Path) -> dict:
    measured = measure(case_id=case_id, context_path=context_path,
                       trace_path=trace_path, receipt_path=receipt_path)
    context = json.loads(Path(context_path).read_text())
    road = context["road_axis"]
    ox, oy = road["origin"]
    ax, ay = road["forward"]
    polygon = context["crosswalk"]["polygon"]
    if not isinstance(polygon, list) or len(polygon) < 3:
        raise ValueError("original crossing polygon required")
    stations = [(point[0] - ox) * ax + (point[1] - oy) * ay for point in polygon]
    if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in stations):
        raise ValueError("finite original crossing entry required")
    entry_station = min(stations)
    rows = measured["observations"]
    if len(rows) != 900 or rows[0]["ego_front_station_m"] >= entry_station:
        raise ValueError("complete original ego crossing approach required")
    entering = next((row for row in rows if row["ego_front_station_m"] >= entry_station), None)
    pedestrian_frames = measured["pedestrian_crosswalk_frames"]
    if entering is None or not pedestrian_frames:
        outcome = "insufficient_ego_entry_or_pedestrian_crossing"
        retry = False
    else:
        last_pedestrian_frame = pedestrian_frames[-1]
        retry = entering["frame"] <= last_pedestrian_frame
        outcome = "timing_overlap" if retry else "timing_clear"
    return {
        "case_id": case_id, "candidate_id": "fallback1" if retry else "primary",
        "retry_trigger_met": retry, "outcome": outcome,
        "ego_crossing_entry_frame": entering["frame"] if entering else None,
        "pedestrian_clearance_last_frame": pedestrian_frames[-1] if pedestrian_frames else None,
        "entry_minus_clearance_s": ((entering["frame"] - pedestrian_frames[-1]) / 20.0
                                    if entering is not None and pedestrian_frames else None),
        "crossing_entry_station_m": entry_station,
        "source_bindings": measured["source_bindings"],
        "physical_acceptance": "unverified", "legal_judgment": "unresolved",
    }

"""Run one source-bound 20 Hz Native crosswalk acquisition attempt.

The saved trace and four videos are original observations. This function does
not claim that the intended pass, stop, crossing or camera visibility occurred.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

from native_crosswalk_actors import NativeCrosswalkActors
from native_crosswalk_capture import NativeCrosswalkRecorder, FRAME_COUNT
from native_crosswalk_media import NativeCrosswalkCameras
from native_crosswalk_world import run_sourced_world


def _context(proposal: dict, site: dict, actor_ids: dict) -> dict:
    inventory = proposal["source_inventory"]
    if site.get("junction_kind") != "road_intersection" or site.get("alley_junction") is not False:
        raise ValueError("source-reviewed road intersection required")
    axis = site.get("road_axis")
    if not isinstance(axis, dict) or set(axis) != {"origin", "forward"}:
        raise ValueError("original road axis required")
    crossing = {"kind": proposal["crosswalk_kind"], "polygon": proposal["crosswalk_polygon"]}
    if proposal["crosswalk_kind"] == "unmarked":
        crossing["opposite_sidewalk_lateral_lines"] = site["opposite_sidewalk_lateral_lines"]
        crossing["curb_or_traveled_edge_sources"] = [inventory["curb_or_edge"]["citation"]]
    else:
        crossing["marking_source"] = inventory["marking"]["citation"]
    return {"case_id": proposal["case_id"], "map_sha256": inventory["map"]["sha256"],
            "map_id": proposal["map_id"], "layout": "intersection", "junction_kind": "road_intersection",
            "crosswalk": crossing, "stopped_vehicle_purpose": {
                "claim": proposal["lead_stop_purpose"],
                "source_ref": inventory["stopped_purpose"]["citation"]},
            "road_axis": axis, "ego_vehicle_identity": actor_ids["ego"],
            "lead_vehicle_identity": actor_ids["lead"], "pedestrian_identity": actor_ids["pedestrian"],
            "source_inventory": inventory, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def capture_case(*, world, carla, proposal: dict, output: str | Path) -> dict:
    """Capture original actors/cameras under the verified, restored world session."""
    root = Path(output)
    if not root.is_dir() or any(root.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError("fresh empty original capture directory required")
    source = Path(proposal["source"]["path"])
    site = json.loads(source.read_bytes())

    def acquire(active_world):
        actors = None
        cameras = None
        try:
            actors = NativeCrosswalkActors(world=active_world, carla=carla, proposal=proposal)
            context = _context(proposal, site, actors.actor_ids)
            recorder = NativeCrosswalkRecorder(case_id=proposal["case_id"], context=context,
                                               actor_ids=actors.actor_ids)
            cameras = NativeCrosswalkCameras(world=active_world, carla=carla, site=site, output=root)
            for _ in range(FRAME_COUNT):
                actors.control()
                frame = active_world.tick()
                images = cameras.append(frame)
                recorder.append(world_frame=frame, actors=actors.observe(frame), camera_frames=images)
            cameras.close(require_complete=True)
            cameras = None
            receipt = recorder.write(root)
            return {"receipt": receipt, "actor_ids": actors.actor_ids,
                    "video_paths": {name: str(root / (name + ".mkv")) for name in
                                    ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")}}
        finally:
            if cameras is not None:
                cameras.close(require_complete=False)
            if actors is not None:
                actors.close()

    return run_sourced_world(world=world, proposal=proposal, capture=acquire)

"""Exact crosswalk construction entrypoint; unsourced launch is rejected."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def check():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    config = json.loads((root / 'config.json').read_text())
    plan_raw = (root / 'case-plan.json').read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(plan_raw).hexdigest() != config['plan_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Exact crosswalk case plan changed')
    plan = json.loads(plan_raw)
    matches = [row for row in plan['cases'] if row['case_id'] == config['selected_case_id']]
    if len(matches) != 1 or config['assignment_id'] != plan['assignment_id']:
        raise ValueError('Exact crosswalk case missing')
    row = matches[0]
    if (row['crosswalk_kind'] != config['crosswalk_kind'] or
            row['ego_maneuver_request'] != config['ego_behavior'] or
            row['stopped_vehicle_purpose_claim'] != config['lead_stop_purpose']):
        raise ValueError('Exact crossing, behavior or purpose target changed')
    if (config['law_id'] != 'LVMC-11-30-030' or config['cell_id'] != 'C229023' or
            config['actor'] != 'motor_vehicle_driver'):
        raise ValueError('Exact crosswalk law/cell/actor changed')
    if (config['rate_hz'] != 20 or config['frame_count'] != 900 or
            config['duration_s'] != 45 or config['cameras'] !=
            ['overview','approach','reference_corner','driver_reference']):
        raise ValueError('Original capture profile changed')
    cap = config.get('engineering_speed_cap_mps')
    if cap is not None and (type(cap) not in (float, int) or not 0 < cap <= 5):
        raise ValueError('Bounded fallback ego speed cap required')
    return config['selected_case_id']


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--site')
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir')
    parser.add_argument('--carla-host', default='127.0.0.1')
    parser.add_argument('--carla-port', type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    case = check()
    if args.check:
        print('diagnostic crosswalk bundle passed: ' + case)
        return
    if not args.site or not args.output_dir:
        raise ValueError('Reviewed road intersection site and original output directory required')
    from case_construction import construct

"""Saved-only crosswalk measurement from original actor and camera sources.

The measured sequence is an engineering observation, not a legal verdict or
physical acceptance of crossing purpose, sight lines, or right of way.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from case_construction import CASES
from crosswalk_measurements import ASSIGNMENT_ID, measure
from saved_video_audit import audit as audit_video


def finalize(*, directory: str | Path, case_id: str, fixture_mode: bool = False) -> dict:
    prefix = ASSIGNMENT_ID + "__"
    if not case_id.startswith(prefix) or case_id[len(prefix):] not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("exact crosswalk case required")
    root = Path(directory)
    if not root.is_dir() or (root / "crosswalk-measurement.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("fresh saved attempt with no prior finalization required")
    measured = measure(case_id=case_id, context_path=root / "context.json",
                       trace_path=root / "trace.jsonl", receipt_path=root / "receipt.json",
                       fixture_mode=fixture_mode)
    media = audit_video(directory=root, case_id=case_id, fixture_mode=fixture_mode)
    if measured["frame_count"] != media["videos"]["overview"]["frames"]:
        raise ValueError("original actor and decoded camera frame counts differ")
    crossing, behavior, purpose = CASES[case_id[len(prefix):]]
    if (measured["crosswalk_kind"], measured["stopped_vehicle_purpose_claim"]) != (crossing, purpose):
        raise ValueError("original crossing kind or purpose differs from exact case")
    observed = {
        "rear_approach_sampled": bool(measured["rear_approach_frames"]),
        "lead_stop_sampled": bool(measured["lead_stopped_frames"]),
        "pedestrian_in_polygon_sampled": bool(measured["pedestrian_crosswalk_frames"]),
        "ego_full_pass_sampled": bool(measured["ego_ahead_frames"]),
    }
    checks = [
        {"target": name, "requested": request, "measured": observed[name],
         "matched": observed[name] == request, "physical_cause_confirmed": False}
        for name, request in (
            ("rear_approach_sampled", True), ("lead_stop_sampled", True),
            ("pedestrian_in_polygon_sampled", True),
            ("ego_full_pass_sampled", behavior == "pass"),
        )
    ]
    report = {
        "format": "crosswalk-saved-measurement",
        "assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT_ID, "case_id": case_id,
        "source_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                          for name in ("context.json", "trace.jsonl", "frame-map.jsonl", "receipt.json")},
        "media": media, "observed": observed, "target_checks": checks,
        "measured_values": measured, "physical_acceptance": "unverified",
        "legal_judgment": "unresolved", "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
        "diagnostic_fixture": fixture_mode,
    }
    (root / "crosswalk-measurement.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    return report
